I will keep my land in the usual wheat and maize rotation. Here in Quzhou County, that is the safest way for me to earn grain and manage risk. I am 74, so I will not choose crops that need too much hand work like cotton or vegetables on a big area. I know wheat and maize well, I can get seed and machine services easily, and I can manage them with fewer decisions. I will finish the winter wheat already in the field with fertilizer, watering, and a few pesticide sprays if I see disease or insects. After harvest, I will quickly sow summer maize on the same land so I do not lose moisture or time. I will use improved seed for wheat and hybrid seed for maize because I want stable yield. I will keep fertilizer at moderate levels, water only as needed, and use rotary tillage for wheat and no-tillage for maize after wheat harvest to save labor and keep the season moving.
